rule: A piece qualifies when the Round check finds correctness PASS, rules kept and the control identical; the target score (sum of weight x time over its target rows, against its start) is at least 1.1 and above 1 + its noise band; and no row of the 14 is slower than its start.
target_rows_rule: The rows whose code path or table entry the piece changes, read from the patch and the two tile tables, not from timings.

pieces.what: Merge SiLU-and-mul into the gate/up multiply on the served path, and replace the top-k sum
Down multiply reuses loaded data across N tiles (COL_LOOP), with retuned large-batch tiles
Transposed decode down multiply, one pipeline stage on small rows, and 256 tokens on the decode path
Retune the large-batch tile table (config only)
Send 512 tokens down the decode path, and one wide load in the decode down multiply
